## At BWXT, we deliver innovative nuclear solutions to create a better world.

## [LEARN MORE >][132]

[BWXT US submarine on top of water]

## Naval Nuclear Propulsion

[BWXT submarine icon white on clear background]
350 +

Naval Nuclear Reactors

We have proudly manufactured naval nuclear components and reactors since the 1950s – we designed and
fabricated components for the USS Nautilus, the world’s first nuclear-powered submarine.

## [LEARN MORE >][133]

[BWXT steam generator cutout on a clear background]

## Commercial Nuclear Power Equipment

[BWXT steam generator icon white on a clear background]
200 +

Nuclear Steam Generators

We are capitalizing on the capabilities of our unique manufacturing facilities to meet the world’s
growing energy demands through nuclear power. 

## [LEARN MORE >][134]

[BWXT Technical Services Group TIG welding employees safety glasses on a clear background]

## Complex Site Operations

[BWXT nuclear technical services icon white on a clear background]
10

High Consequence Sites

Managed for the U.S. Government

We are making significant contributions to a cleaner future environment through our involvement with
the U.S. Department of Energy Environmental Management projects.

## Who We Are

### Our Vision: To be the region’s **most recognized, trusted and respected** full service
### facilities experts

With over five decades of expertise and a leading presence in the industry, AMS is a regional
mechanical contractor specializing in the design, installation, and service of heating, ventilation,
air conditioning, and plumbing systems for commercial, industrial, and institutional clients. Our
specialties include plumbing and process piping, sheet metal fabrication, MEP, system retrofits,
service, controls, design-build, plan & spec, and fast-track projects.

AMS brings a broad blend of expertise to our customers. Our combination of experience, advanced
technology, and customer-focused service allows us to find new and better ways to meet your needs
quickly and cost-effectively. The result? Services that keep your business up and running, with
support that builds long-lasting relationships.

Our mission is to lead the mechanical construction industry with continuous growth and profitability
by providing our employees with an honest and collaborative work environment—one where they can
dedicate themselves to delivering exceptional workmanship and extraordinary customer service.

[ Learn More ][37]

## Our Expertise

### Services that keep your business up and running and support that builds long-lasting
### relationships.

### Design + Build

Bring our expertise in-house. Our engineering department is among the industry’s most respected-
offering the scale, experience, and talent to support your operations. With professional engineers
and skilled CAD operators on staff, AMS provides a seamless in-house resource from concept to
completion.

Products & Services

## What We Do

From new installations to full retrofits, BHL Cooling Tower delivers cooling tower solutions
tailored to your project scope and budget.

### Cooling Tower Retrofit

Upgrade your existing cooling tower without full replacement. We assess, redesign, and replace
ageing components — fill media, fan systems, drift eliminators, and structure — to restore peak
thermal performance and extend equipment life.
* Fill Media Replacement
* Fan & Motor Upgrade
* Structural Refurbishment
* Performance Testing

### Custom Made Cooling Tower

Not every project is a catalogue. We engineer cooling towers to your exact thermal load, site
dimensions, noise limits, and water quality requirements — from single cell FRP units to large
multi-cell structures.
* Thermal Sizing to Spec
* Custom Footprint & Height
* Material Selection
* Full Engineering Documentation

### New Cooling Tower

Supply and installation of new FRP, crossflow or counterflow cooling towers for commercial,
industrial, and power plant applications. Factory-direct pricing with full technical support from
selection through commissioning.
* FRP / Crossflow / Counterflow
* 10 RT - 3,000 RT Capacity
* Supply & Installation
* Commissioning Support

### Not sure what you need?

Speak to our engineers — we'll help you select the right solution for your application, project
budget, and timeline.

## About Us


At the Cooling Technology Institute, our mission is to advocate and promote the use of all
environmentally responsible commercial cooling technologies. From information exchanges to dialogs
on the benefits of different cooling technologies with government agencies the world over, we work
hard to present a forum that unites manufacturers, suppliers, and owners and operators with a single
voice dedicated to safety and innovation. Learn more about who we are and the work we do every day.

[ Learn More ][86]

### Become a Member

[Register Now][87]

You can have a say in the forum that governs your industry. Whether you represent a corporation that
delivers cooling towers, a single plant operating an industrial evaporative heat transfer system, a
firm of water treatment experts, or a parts supplier of any size, your voice can be heard by your
peers, industry veterans, and decision-makers. Join a committee. Submit a paper. Get involved.
That’s CTI Membership.

## [More Cooling Tower Manufacturers][71]


### Cooling Tower Supplier Directory Overview

At Cooling Towers, buyers can find and compare cooling tower manufacturers, browse cooling tower
suppliers, and connect with cooling tower companies serving demanding industrial and commercial
applications. This directory helps sourcing teams evaluate industrial cooling towers, commercial
cooling towers, and related system options for power generation, manufacturing, HVAC, food
processing, chemical handling, and other heat-intensive operations. Whether you need to source
standard units or application-specific systems, this page is built to help users compare
capabilities, review equipment types, and identify cooling tower manufacturers in the USA that match
operating conditions, throughput goals, and installation requirements.

### Open Cooling Towers vs Closed Loop Systems

Open cooling towers are widely used when facilities need efficient evaporative heat rejection for
large circulating water loops. Buyers often browse these systems for industrial cooling towers in
power generation, heavy manufacturing, refineries, and large HVAC operations because they support
consistent heat removal and scalable plant performance. Closed loop systems are often sourced when
process fluid protection matters, especially in chemical processing, pharmaceutical production, food
manufacturing, and applications where contamination control and water quality affect output.

### Counterflow and Crossflow Cooling Tower Designs

Counterflow and crossflow designs serve different airflow and maintenance preferences, so buyers
comparing cooling tower manufacturers often review both styles side by side. Counterflow units are
frequently selected for compact industrial cooling solutions where vertical airflow supports thermal
performance in tighter layouts. Crossflow units are commonly considered for commercial cooling tower
installations, institutional facilities, and larger building systems where accessibility,
serviceability, and water distribution patterns influence the final specification.

### Cooling Tower Supplier Directory Overview

At Cooling Towers, buyers can find and compare cooling tower manufacturers, browse cooling tower
suppliers, and connect with cooling tower companies serving demanding industrial and commercial
applications. This directory helps sourcing teams evaluate industrial cooling towers, commercial
cooling towers, and related system options for power generation, manufacturing, HVAC, food
processing, chemical handling, and other heat-intensive operations. Whether you need to source
standard units or application-specific systems, this page is built to help users compare
capabilities, review equipment types, and identify cooling tower manufacturers in the USA that match
operating conditions, throughput goals, and installation requirements.

### Open Cooling Towers vs Closed Loop Systems

Open cooling towers are widely used when facilities need efficient evaporative heat rejection for
large circulating water loops. Buyers often browse these systems for industrial cooling towers in
power generation, heavy manufacturing, refineries, and large HVAC operations because they support
consistent heat removal and scalable plant performance. Closed loop systems are often sourced when
process fluid protection matters, especially in chemical processing, pharmaceutical production, food
manufacturing, and applications where contamination control and water quality affect output.

### Counterflow and Crossflow Cooling Tower Designs

Counterflow and crossflow designs serve different airflow and maintenance preferences, so buyers
comparing cooling tower manufacturers often review both styles side by side. Counterflow units are
frequently selected for compact industrial cooling solutions where vertical airflow supports thermal
performance in tighter layouts. Crossflow units are commonly considered for commercial cooling tower
installations, institutional facilities, and larger building systems where accessibility,
serviceability, and water distribution patterns influence the final specification.

designed for aerofoil construction. The blades are of adjustable pitch connected to a common

installation capacity and having gear reducer in large capacity models thus enabling us to
successfully assembly for fan.

Special low rpm motor of vertical, flange type or foot mounted with extended & threaded shaft and
sealed top is supplied with the cooling tower. The motor is also ‘F’ class insulated IP-55 grade
weather proof and continuous rating.

#### FILLS

As per cooling tower we have various types of fill packing which is used in different conditions.
Such as water temperature is higher, atmosphere is polluted or water saving. We have one ultimate
solution for it. We design & customize fills as per client requirement.

# API Inspection & API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment

**Inspection 4 Industry LLC** provides API inspection training and API 579 Fitness for Service
Assessment (FFS) services for the oil and gas and process industries, supporting pressure vessels,
piping systems, and aboveground storage tanks.

I4I Academy provides Online API Inspector Training Courses, including API 510 pressure vessel
inspector training course, API 570 piping inspector training course, API 653 aboveground storage
tank inspector training course, API Source inspector training course, API 1104 welding of pipelines
and related facilities training course, API 571 Corrosion and Materials training course, and API 580
Risk Based Inspection training course. Multiple ASME courses are also provided, including courses
about ASME Section VIII Div.1, IX, and V.

Inspection 4 Industry LLC provides [API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment][170] (FFS) services for
common damage mechanisms (metal loss, pitting, cracking, hydrogen damage, dents and gouges, fire
damage, creep, laminations, fatigue, and more). If API 579 FFS is needed for your equipment, contact
Inspection 4 Industry LLC and we can perform the assessment and deliver a complete engineering
report with a clear fit-for-service decision and any required operating limits.


## API Inspection Training Courses

Welcome to the [I4I Academy][171], where our online API Inspector Training courses stand out with an
unparalleled success rate in API Individual Certification Program Exams. We take pride in achieving
a remarkable pass rate of over 95% for participants in our API 510, API 570, and API 653 training
courses, with the majority succeeding in their certification exams on the very first attempt.

# API Inspection & API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment

**Inspection 4 Industry LLC** provides API inspection training and API 579 Fitness for Service
Assessment (FFS) services for the oil and gas and process industries, supporting pressure vessels,
piping systems, and aboveground storage tanks.

I4I Academy provides Online API Inspector Training Courses, including API 510 pressure vessel
inspector training course, API 570 piping inspector training course, API 653 aboveground storage
tank inspector training course, API Source inspector training course, API 1104 welding of pipelines
and related facilities training course, API 571 Corrosion and Materials training course, and API 580
Risk Based Inspection training course. Multiple ASME courses are also provided, including courses
about ASME Section VIII Div.1, IX, and V.

Inspection 4 Industry LLC provides [API 579 Fitness for Service Assessment][170] (FFS) services for
common damage mechanisms (metal loss, pitting, cracking, hydrogen damage, dents and gouges, fire
damage, creep, laminations, fatigue, and more). If API 579 FFS is needed for your equipment, contact
Inspection 4 Industry LLC and we can perform the assessment and deliver a complete engineering
report with a clear fit-for-service decision and any required operating limits.


## API Inspection Training Courses

Welcome to the [I4I Academy][171], where our online API Inspector Training courses stand out with an
unparalleled success rate in API Individual Certification Program Exams. We take pride in achieving
a remarkable pass rate of over 95% for participants in our API 510, API 570, and API 653 training
courses, with the majority succeeding in their certification exams on the very first attempt.

raffreddatori adiabatici, dry cooler, condensatori evaporativi e chiller. Risparmio energia e acqua
grazie alle molteplici soluzioni e alle simulazioni dei nostri software comparativi.

# Your Nationwide Partner for Every Cooling Tower Need

Rebuild & Repair, Service & Maintenance, Inspections, and Parts-handled by one team.

## Our Core Services

At OBR Cooling Towers, we provide a comprehensive range of services to ensure your cooling systems
operate at peak performance. From proactive maintenance to custom-built solutions, our expertise
ensures longevity, efficiency, and reliability for your cooling towers. Whether you need routine
inspections, new installations, repairs, or high-quality replacement parts, our team is committed to
delivering the best solutions for your industry needs.

### Service Group

Cleanings, preventative maintenance, and documentation for performance optimization.

[optimize your cooling system][15]

### Rebuild & Repairs

Tower upgrades, structural repairs, and installation for all makes and models.

[discover custom cooling solutions][16]

### Parts Warehouse

High-quality, ready-to-ship OEM and after-market cooling tower components.

[find the right cooling tower parts][17]
[OBR CoilCare. OBR tech power washing coils]

### CoilCare™

Professional coil cleaning that helps improve HVAC performance and extend equipment life.

[View CoilCare™ Services][18]

## Inspections

Examination of critical mechanical components, structural integrity, and safety requirements.

[prevent failures before they happen][19]

## What Sets Us Apart

#### Trusted Nationwide. Built on Precision. Backed by People Who Care.

At OBR Cooling Towers, we don’t just build and service towers—we build long-term partnerships rooted
in trust, performance, and accountability. With over 30 years of experience and a coast-to-coast
presence, we deliver solutions that keep your systems efficient, safe, and reliable.

### In-House Engineering & Fabrication

Our dedicated team of mechanical engineers and fabricators delivers tailored solutions with
precision and speed—no outsourcing, no delays.

### Nationwide Service Coverage

With regional hubs and field crews across the U.S., we’re ready to respond wherever your towers are
located.

### Comprehensive Services Under One Roof

From inspections and maintenance to full tower builds and custom parts—we do it all, simplifying
vendor management for your team.

### Vertically Integrated Logistics

Our internal logistics operation ensures faster delivery of materials and components—reducing
downtime and project delays.

### Certified Safety Culture (HEIGHTS Program)

We prioritize the safety of your site and our people through rigorous planning, training, and
adherence to the highest safety standards.

### Responsive, Detail-Driven Support

We go beyond the job—we provide clear communication, thorough reporting, and long-term solutions
that keep your systems running strong.

## About OBR Cooling Towers

With over 30 years of experience, OBR Cooling Towers has grown into a nationwide leader in cooling
tower solutions, supporting critical infrastructure across refineries, power generation, healthcare,
data centers, industrial facilities, and beyond. Backed by a team of 450+ employees across 10+
locations, we deliver the scale, speed, and technical expertise our customers rely on.

Our vertically integrated model includes engineering, inspections, parts supply, field services,
custom fabrication, logistics, and preventative maintenance—allowing us to provide full-service
solutions that maximize reliability, extend equipment life, and reduce downtime.

## ABOUT US

### We Offer The Best

Tower Tech Cooling Systems Pvt Ltd started operating in 1996, with a vast domain of operations and
multifaceted services; Tower Tech is considered to be one of the best cooling tower manufacturers,
suppliers, and exporters in India. We manufacture a wide range of cooling towers that include FRP
cooling towers, field-erected cooling towers, bottle cooling towers, cross-flow cooling towers,
induced draft cooling towers, evaporative cooling towers, and many such products that make us the
one-stop-shop for all industrial and manufacturing cooling requirements. 

We specialize in the manufacturing of the cooling tower’s spare parts, including the PVC fills. As
such buyers will find it convenient to fulfill all requirements in one place. Tower Tech Cooling
Systems Pvt Ltd is ISO 9001:2015 certified, therefore does not compromise on quality. We lay a large
emphasis on the quality of manufacturing and also provide maintenance services to ensure our clients
are satisfied. We are also a member of CTI-USA which makes us a quality provider in terms of cooling
systems, their parts, upgradation, and maintenance in all the industries we serve. We have a
stringent quality management system that monitors the production cycle of each product at every
stage.

Machines, Industrial Hydraulic Cylinders, Vertical Grow Bag Machines, Fuel Briquette Press Machines,
and other products. Our products are well-engineered at our advanced manufacturing facility under
the strict supervision of our professionals. The experts are well-trained and highly competent. They
make use of the best raw materials available in the market to manufacture a product range that is
unique, desirable, durable, and cost-worthy. We thoroughly check all the products on different
parameters before their dispatch to be sure of delivering only the best to our esteemed customers.

**Our Mission and Vision **

Our mission is to provide our valued customers with innovative industrial solutions that are
tailor-made to suit their demands and requirements. Our goal is to be recognized as the leading name
in the industry that is reliable and capable of satisfying the demands of its customers to the
fullest.

**Quality Assurance **

Only the finest raw materials sourced from reliable vendors are used to manufacture all of our
products. Our team of adept quality specialists and production experts work together in coordination
to bring forth an excellent product range. The quality specialists keep an eye on the production
process and carefully monitor it to ensure no damaged product is moved further in the process,
whereas our production experts flawlessly develop and design the products as per the requirements of
our customers. Once the production is done, all the products are subjected to a series of quality
tests. Each product is thoroughly tested on varied industrial parameters. The products that comply
with international quality standards and stand out in terms of design, durability, performance,
efficiency, etc., are made available in the market. Furthermore, owing to our strict quality
management and control, we have been certified by the Coir Board of India.

**Why Choose Us? **

For multiple reasons, we, Unitek Hydraulics, are the best choice in the market for customers when it
comes to purchasing quality-assured Garden Pot Making Machines, Industrial Cooling Towers, Fuel
Briquette Press Machines, Industrial Hydraulic Cylinders, Vertical Grow Bag Machines, and other
products. Listed below are a few of the significant reasons why we are the most preferred name in
the industry:

* Extensive Industry Experience: We have an experience of over a decade in the business. We are well
  aware of the market dynamics and have strong business acumen.
* Over 250 Successful Installations: With the support of our team of profoundly talented and
  competent professionals, we have been able to promptly and smoothly install over 250 of our
  equipment at varied locations around the globe.
* State-of-the-art Infrastructure: Our infrastructure sprawls over an area of 8000 ft., housing
  various units such as production, quality control, packaging, warehouse, research and development,
  marketing and sales, etc.
* Prompt Delivery of Consignments: We love to be punctual. Hence, all the orders are timely
  delivered by us to their desired locations. We make use of the fastest and safest delivery
  channels to ship the orders.
* Wide Market Presence: In a short time period, our company has achieved remarkable success in the
  hydraulic machinery sector. It is the exceptional affordability and premium quality of our
